# #4936: Patch: `permanents_on_field` meets a card lying on a unit zone after its side's backrow
Opened by @jgoetzmann-bot.

## What it actually means

Ticketed can stack itself onto an enemy Unit, where it lies on that unit zone: not a Unit, but still a permanent. The rules say a sweep of every permanent meets such a card after its side's backrow zones. One list in the engine still puts it up among the Units instead. That list feeds the plague-placement options, random plague placements, random exiles of the field, and the Radiant-field pool, so on such a board the same seed can offer or hit a different card than the rules' order says. After the fix, every every-permanent list agrees on the pinned order.

## Why

spec/03-zones.md (Stack bullet) pins the order, citing R4665000: a sweep of the backrow, of the Field Spells, or of every permanent meets a lying card after that side's backrow zones. Patch #4760 fixed the sibling lists to match: `enemy_permanents` (crates/engine/src/query.rs), `backrow_of` (crates/engine/src/state_check.rs:120-127), `field_spells_doomed` (crates/engine/src/effects/datacenter.rs:142-145), and `is_adjacent_card` (crates/engine/src/zones.rs:1740-1742). It missed `permanents_on_field` (crates/engine/src/plague.rs:32-38), which walks `acting_on` (crates/engine/src/zones.rs), and that walk pushes every unit-zone top unfiltered, lying cards included. The helper for the pinned spot already exists (`lying_on_unit_zones_of`, crates/engine/src/zones.rs:1767). Consumers of the missed list: plague prompt options and random placements (crates/engine/src/effects/plague.rs:194), random field exiles (crates/engine/src/effects/move_.rs:133), the Radiant-field pool (crates/engine/src/effects/radiant.rs:114), and anomaly copies (crates/engine/src/effects/anomaly.rs:194). Only Ticketed creates lying cards today, so the blast radius is tiny but the divergence is observable through seeded picks.

## Proposal

In `permanents_on_field`, filter lying tops out of each side's `acting_on` pass and append `lying_on_unit_zones_of` after the backrow section, the exact pattern `enemy_permanents` and `backrow_of` already use, and update the doc comment to cite R4665000. Leave `acting_on` itself untouched: aura and field-text reads correctly include the lying top since its auras project. Add a scenario test in the Ticketed module plus one seeded-pick test.

## Where it lands

crates/engine/src/plague.rs (`permanents_on_field`; `reachable_permanents_on_field` inherits it). Tests in crates/cards/src/scripts/stinkyscape/c009_ticketed.rs, which already holds lying-card scenarios. No spec change: the spec already states the rule, the implementation catches up.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] A card lying on a unit zone is met after its side's backrow tops in `permanents_on_field` / `reachable_permanents_on_field`, per side
- [ ] It is met exactly once (count unchanged: no drop, no double-count)
- [ ] Plague placement options list it after backrow cards; seeded random placements and exiles over such a board match the spec order
- [ ] Boards without lying cards produce byte-identical lists (no golden churn outside lying-card games)
- [ ] Engine and card test suites green

## Size and risks

S. Risk is low and bounded: only boards with a card lying on a unit zone (only Ticketed today) combined with these effects change outcome; both seats share the engine so there is no client skew.

_Written by `claude-4` (claude, `opus`, strong) ([run](https://github.com/Jlore-Studios/JackiOh/actions/runs/45667255960)) before anyone built this. The night bot's builder starts from this section: edit it here to change the plan._

## Goal

`permanents_on_field` in `crates/engine/src/plague.rs`, and through it `reachable_permanents_on_field`, must list a card lying on a unit zone (S #9 Ticketed stacked on a Unit) after its side's backrow tops. That holds for each side, for either value of `first`, and the card appears exactly once. Boards with no lying card must list exactly what they list today. The proof is three tests in the Ticketed module:
- the list order;
- the plague placement prompt's option order;
- a seeded `exileRandomFrom` draw over the field that follows the spec's order.

No spec change: `spec/03-zones.md` (Stack bullet) and R4665000 already state the rule.

**Where this departs from muse's plan, and why:**
- **The list test gets a permanent on P1's side.** With P1's side empty, muse's test 1 could not tell "after its own side's backrow" from "at the very end of the list".
- **Test 2 is replaced.** Muse's version shuffled two hand-built lists and never ran engine code. The new tests read a real prompt and run a real draw through the engine.
- **The code is a plain loop instead of `flat_map` plus an inner `collect`.** It does the same thing in a form that surely compiles.
- **A classify step is added.** CI's `rust (classify)` replays games against the base build and requires a pending fragment for every card it shows playing differently (R1370000).

## Files to touch

| File | New/change | What changes |
|---|---|---|
| `crates/engine/src/plague.rs` | change | `zones` import; body and doc comment of `permanents_on_field` |
| `crates/cards/src/scripts/stinkyscape/c009_ticketed.rs` | change | `mod tests`: constant `BRINGER` and helpers `permanent_ids` and `option_ids`; `mod base`: three tests |
| `crates/cards/patches/pending/<slug>.json` | new, **only if step 7 finds a card that plays differently** | Fragment written by `cargo jackioh patches`, with `--plays` and a hand-written `player` note |

Do not touch:
- `crates/engine/src/zones.rs`: `acting_on` stays as it is, because aura and field-text reads need the lying top.
- `reachable_permanents_on_field`, and the consumers in `crates/engine/src/effects/{plague,move_,radiant,anomaly}.rs`. They inherit the fix.
- `spec/`: no new ruling. R4665000 governs and already lists `c009_ticketed.rs` in `proven_in`.
- `.github/`, `.harness/`, `.squishy/`, `bot/`.

## Steps

1. **Build the base binary before any edit.** If `git status --porcelain` and `git log --oneline origin/main..HEAD` both print nothing, run:
   ```
   cargo build --release -p jackioh-tools && cp target/release/jackioh /tmp/jackioh-base-4936
   ```
   Otherwise, run `scripts/worktree.sh classify-base "$(git merge-base origin/main HEAD)"`, then `cargo build --release -p jackioh-tools` inside `../jackioh-wt/classify-base`, and copy that `target/release/jackioh` to `/tmp/jackioh-base-4936`.

2. **Fix the list.** In `crates/engine/src/plague.rs`:
   - Change the import to:
     `use crate::zones::{StandingAt, acting_on, is_buried, lies_on_unit_zone, lying_on_unit_zones_of};`
   - Replace the body of `permanents_on_field`, keeping its signature, with:
   ```rust
       let first = first.into().unwrap_or(state.active);
       let mut out: Vec<&CardInstance> = Vec::new();
       for player in [first, opponent_of(first)] {
           // R4665000: a card lying on a unit zone is no Unit; it is met after its side's backrow lanes.
           out.extend(
               acting_on(state, player, StandingAt::ItsLane)
                   .into_iter()
                   .filter(|card| !lies_on_unit_zone(state, card)),
           );
           out.extend(lying_on_unit_zones_of(state, player));
       }
       out
   ```
   This copies the pattern of `enemy_permanents` (`crates/engine/src/query.rs:715-721`). A lying card has no position and sits only in the units row, so the filter drops it once and the `extend` adds it back once.

3. **Update the doc comment** on `permanents_on_field` to:
   ```rust
   /// Every permanent on the field in R68's order — the given side first (the active player's when
   /// `first` is `None`), units lane 1 upward, the Units its carriers hold, the backrow lane 1 upward,
   /// then the cards lying on that side's unit zones, then the other side the same way
   /// (`zones::acting_on`, `zones::lying_on_unit_zones_of`): the top of a unit pile only (R13), a Unit a
   /// carrier holds (R446, R1824000), every backrow card, face-down or not, and a card lying on a unit
   /// zone, no Unit but a backrow card there, after its side's backrow lanes (R4665000).
   ```

4. **Add the test helpers.** In `c009_ticketed.rs`, `mod tests`:
   - Add `const BRINGER: &str = "classic-076"; // Plague Bringer: "Cry: Place 2 Plague Counters. Draw 1."` after `MAYOR`.
   - After `scope_ids`, add:
   ```rust
   /// The ids `permanents_on_field` lists (`reachable_permanents_on_field` with `reachable`), `first`'s side first.
   fn permanent_ids(s: &Scenario, first: PlayerId, reachable: bool) -> Vec<String> {
       let cards = if reachable {
           jackioh_engine::query::reachable_permanents_on_field(s.state(), first)
       } else {
           jackioh_engine::query::permanents_on_field(s.state(), first)
       };
       cards.into_iter().map(|card| card.id.clone()).collect()
   }

   /// The instance ids the open prompt offers, in order.
   fn option_ids(s: &Scenario) -> Vec<String> {
       must(s.state().pending.as_ref(), "an open prompt")
           .options
           .iter()
           .filter_map(|option| match &option.selection {
               Selection::Instance { instance_id } => Some(instance_id.clone()),
               _ => None,
           })
           .collect()
   }
   ```

5. **Add the three tests** to `mod base`, right after `r4665000_enemy_permanents_lists_it_after_their_backrow`. Each gets a `///` comment citing R4665000; test C's also cites R60.

   **A. `r4665000_every_permanent_meets_it_after_that_sides_backrow_and_once`:**
   - Set up: `let (mut s, [left, pawn, ticketed, _]) = stacked(json!([BRINGER])); s.play(BRINGER, json!({})); let bringer = s.card(BRINGER).id.clone();`. The Cry's prompt stays open, which is fine for reading state.
   - Assert `permanent_ids(&s, P1, false)` and `permanent_ids(&s, P1, true)` each equal `vec![bringer.clone(), left.clone(), pawn.clone(), ticketed.clone()]`.
   - Assert `permanent_ids(&s, P2, false)` and `permanent_ids(&s, P2, true)` each equal `vec![left, pawn, ticketed, bringer]`, cloning as needed.
   - The P2-first lists show the lying card is met per side: before the other side, not at the very end. The fixed lengths show it is met exactly once. Before the fix the P2 lists read `[left, ticketed, pawn, bringer]`.

   **B. `r4665000_a_plague_placement_offers_it_after_that_sides_backrow`:**
   - Same setup as A.
   - Assert `option_ids(&s) == vec![bringer, left, pawn, ticketed.clone()]`.
   - Then `s.answer(json!(ticketed));` and assert `s.card(ticketed.as_str()).counters.plague == Some(2)`.

   **C. `r4665000_a_random_exile_of_the_field_draws_over_the_spec_order`:**
   ```rust
   let (mut s, [left, pawn, ticketed, _]) = stacked(json!([]));
   let spec = vec![left.clone(), pawn.clone(), ticketed.clone()];
   let among_units = vec![left, ticketed, pawn]; // where the list put it before R4665000's order
   let seed = s.state().seed.clone();
   let cursor = cursor_where(&seed, |cursor| {
       create_rng(&seed, cursor).shuffle(&spec)[0] != create_rng(&seed, cursor).shuffle(&among_units)[0]
   });
   let hit = create_rng(&seed, cursor).shuffle(&spec)[0].clone();
   let spared = create_rng(&seed, cursor).shuffle(&among_units)[0].clone();
   let mut events: Vec<GameEvent> = Vec::new();
   let mut rng = create_rng(&seed, cursor);
   {
       let mut sink = EngineSink::new(s.state_mut(), &mut events, &mut rng);
       let mut ctx = make_context(
           &mut sink,
           None,
           HookOptions { controller: Some(P1), ..HookOptions::default() },
       );
       let exile = jackioh_engine::effects::exile_random_from(json_as(json!({
           "player": "enemy", "from": "field", "count": 1,
       })));
       jackioh_engine::resolve::apply_effects(&[exile], &mut ctx);
   }
   s.expect_in_zone(hit.as_str(), "exile");
   s.expect_in_zone(spared.as_str(), "field");
   ```
   - This follows `scope_ids` and `crates/cards/src/scripts/classic_plus/c070_chaos_machine.rs:276-295`.
   - `exile_random_from` shuffles the ids first thing (`crates/engine/src/effects/move_.rs:133-150`). The searched cursor is one where the spec order and the old order pick different cards, so the test fails before the fix by construction.
   - `cursor_where` comes from the testkit (`crates/engine/src/testkit/seed_search.rs`). Pinning no cursor keeps the test valid under `scripts/pool-probe.sh`.

6. **Format:** run `cargo fmt`, then check `git diff --stat`. Only the two files may change.

7. **Classify:**
   ```
   cargo jackioh classify --base origin/main --parent-bin /tmp/jackioh-base-4936 --claims
   ```
   - **If it passes:** add no fragment. A fragment that claims nothing fails `patches check`, and #4845 (8972c092ce) shipped an engine fix the same way.
   - **If it names cards with "plays differently, but no pending fragment claims it":** run
     ```
     cargo jackioh patches "Patch: every-permanent lists meet a card lying on a unit zone after its side's backrow" --source "#4936" --notes "R4665000: query::permanents_on_field and reachable_permanents_on_field (plague placements, random field exiles, the Radiant-field pool, anomaly copies) meet a card lying on a unit zone (S #9 Ticketed stacked on a Unit) after that side's backrow lanes, as the walks #4760 fixed do; a board with no lying card lists as before. classify stage 2 against the merge base's build names <ids>. No KEPT_SCRIPTS entry: no script changed; replays it alters are refused as rules_changed (R767000)." --plays <the ids it named>
     ```
     Add `--rule` only if classify asks for it.
   - **If you wrote a fragment:** fill its `player` by hand:
     - `"title": "Ticketed on a Unit is met after the backrow"`
     - `"fixes": ["Random effects over every permanent on the field, and the choice of where a Plague Counter goes, now meet a Ticketed stacked on a Unit after that side's backrow cards, as other effects that reach every permanent do."]`
     - Leave the other lists empty. Then rerun the classify command until it passes.
   - If step 1 made a worktree, remove it: `git worktree remove --force ../jackioh-wt/classify-base && git branch -D wt/classify-base`.

8. **Record the decisions** in `.bot-notes.md`:
   - no fragment, or why there is one;
   - the per-side order, rejecting "all lying cards at the end of the list";
   - random plague placement is not tested separately, because it draws an index into the same list whose order test B pins.

## Tests

All three new tests go in `crates/cards/src/scripts/stinkyscape/c009_ticketed.rs`, `mod tests::base`:
- `r4665000_every_permanent_meets_it_after_that_sides_backrow_and_once`: the order of both functions for both `first` values, with fixed lengths.
- `r4665000_a_plague_placement_offers_it_after_that_sides_backrow`: the prompt's option order, and that the placement lands on Ticketed.
- `r4665000_a_random_exile_of_the_field_draws_over_the_spec_order`: the seeded pick follows the spec's order.

Commands:
```
cargo test -p jackioh-cards c009_ticketed
cargo test -p jackioh-cards -- c076_plague_bringer c062_living_bomb c059_plague_doctor c231_the_black_box c069_the_maestro c053_prestige
cargo test -p jackioh-engine --features testkit
cargo test -p jackioh-cards
cargo fmt --check
cargo clippy -p jackioh-engine --all-targets -- -D warnings
cargo clippy -p jackioh-cards --all-targets -- -D warnings
cargo jackioh spec check
cargo jackioh patches check
cargo jackioh classify --base origin/main --parent-bin /tmp/jackioh-base-4936 --claims
cargo jackioh fuzz --seeds 200
```

## Done when

- [ ] A lying card is listed after its side's backrow and before the other side, in both functions and for both `first` values (test A).
- [ ] It is listed exactly once (test A's lengths).
- [ ] Plague placement options list it after the backrow cards (test B), and a seeded random field exile follows the spec's order (test C). All three tests fail on the old order.
- [ ] Boards with no lying card list as before: the filter does nothing and the extra list is empty. The existing engine and card suites pass unchanged.
- [ ] Step 7's classify passes, with a fragment only if it asked for one.
- [ ] rustfmt, both clippy runs, spec check and patches check pass, and all the test commands above are green.
- [ ] No files are changed beyond the table, and no extra worktree is left behind.

## Risks

- **Determinism and replay.** The list is still built from walks in lane order plus one walk in lane order, so a given (seed, cursor) still reproduces. Only games with a lying card change. Replays of those games are refused as `rules_changed` (R767000). No golden fixture holds a stacked Ticketed: searching `crates/*/tests` and `e2e` found Ticketed only in `crates/cards/tests/cross/`, in tests that don't read this list's order.
- **CI classify.** Living Bomb's destroy order and the AI's choice among prompt options can differ on lying-card boards. Step 7 settles this before push; skipping it risks a red `rust (classify)`.
- **Hidden information.** The prompt offers the same set of options in a new order. Face-down options still carry only their id (R177).
- **`acting_on` callers** (auras, field text, triggers) are unaffected because `acting_on` itself is not edited.

## Open questions

None.
